body: SCOUT RUNNABLE SIBLING SWEEP confirms and widens the derived-result population on candidate content 18fe290, disposable ordinary clone only. All inputs are finite and accepted. Exact outputs: Sum(max,max) -> Observed(+Inf); Mean(max,max) -> Observed(+Inf); Variance(max,-max) -> Observed(+Inf); Slope(max,-max) -> Observed(-Inf); WeightedMean(value=1, weights=max,max) -> Observed(NaN); scalar Gaussian kernel(max,max) -> Observed(+Inf); kernelAt Gaussian(max,max) -> Observed(+Inf). Estimate.finite returned None for all seven. Maximum is the natural finite control. Therefore patching WeightedMean alone leaves six sibling doors. Required boundary: every derived scalar passes through Estimate.score or an equivalent finite-result constructor; stable mean/weighted/kernel arithmetic may preserve representable answers, but at minimum fail closed as Undefined(NotFinite). Add aggregate courts naming the reducer branches plus the separate kernelAt factory. Focused probe 1/1, exact console values recorded; no reserved path touched.
